data.narrative:
Valinor Enterprises is a Series A defense & security company founded by Trae Stephens and Grant Verstandig that has raised $85M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 10 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage companies: 2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private entities including Anduril Industries, Shield AI, and Helsing.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a typical 2.0x step-up multiplier to the $85M raised proxy, implying $170M. Peer-median analysis references 10 Defense & Security comparables spanning Series B stage, with valuations ranging from $125M to $3.0B; the median across this set is $1.0B, though most sampled peers (Dream Security at $3.0B, Harmattan AI at $1.4B, Code Metal at $1.2B, Castelion and Defense Unicorns each at $1.0B) sit materially ahead of Valinor's stage.

The two-method triangulation supports a valuation range of $144M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median estimate of $585M. The wide range reflects stage-discount tension: stage-progression anchors conservatively at $170M, while peer medians—despite stage and selection bias toward later-round, well-capitalized peers—suggest substantially higher valuations. Key uncertainties include revenue traction and capital efficiency relative to the peer set, neither of which are provided in available data.
